🧭 TRAJECTOID LAB — ROLLING PATH SIMULATOR

Design a repeating path and watch a custom rolling body follow it.

SCIENCE SANDBOX
What is a trajectoid? A trajectoid is a specially shaped 3D object designed to roll along a chosen repeating path. This lightweight 2D visualization demonstrates the idea; it is not a full 3D shape-generation or rigid-body physics solver.
Distance0.0
Rotations0.0
Path patternSmooth wave
StatusReady

Custom path: choose “Custom path”, then click or tap the canvas to add waypoints. Add at least 2 points to create a route.

🧊 3D Trajectoid Model

Live 3D-style model shown separately underneath the path simulation.

Target path

The glowing line is the repeating route the custom body is designed to trace.

3D rolling model

The separate model underneath rotates to match the rolling simulation.

Compare

A conventional round wheel prefers a straight path; a trajectoid is shaped for a more unusual route.

The 2D simulation and separate 3D-style model are visual demonstrations. The rolling physics are simplified, not a manufacturing-grade no-slip solver.
